# Import mappings

These tables list what **Preferences: Import from Another Editor...** can bring over. Anything not listed here is shown in the review panel as *not imported*, with the reason. How the import works is in [Import settings from another editor](../guides/import-from-another-editor.md).

## Settings

The left column is the name in the other editor. The right column is the key in `config.json` (see [Settings](settings.md)). Values are converted where needed, for example `on` and `off` become true and false.

### VS Code, VSCodium, Cursor and Windsurf

| Setting in the other editor | termocode setting |
| --- | --- |
| `editor.tabSize` | `tab_size` |
| `editor.wordWrap` | `word_wrap` |
| `files.autoSave` | `auto_save` |
| `files.exclude` | `show_hidden` |
| `search.maxResults` | `search_max_results` |

### Zed

| Setting in the other editor | termocode setting |
| --- | --- |
| `autosave` | `auto_save` |
| `soft_wrap` | `word_wrap` |
| `tab_size` | `tab_size` |

### Helix

| Setting in the other editor | termocode setting |
| --- | --- |
| `editor.auto-save` | `auto_save` |
| `editor.soft-wrap.enable` | `word_wrap` |

### JetBrains IDEs

| Setting in the other editor | termocode setting |
| --- | --- |
| `SAVE_FILES_ON_FRAME_DEACTIVATION` | `auto_save` |
| `TAB_SIZE` | `tab_size` |
| `USE_SOFT_WRAPS` | `word_wrap` |
| `autoSaveIfInactive` | `auto_save` |
| `saveOnFrameDeactivation` | `auto_save` |
| `tabSize` | `tab_size` |

### Sublime Text

| Setting in the other editor | termocode setting |
| --- | --- |
| `save_on_focus_lost` | `auto_save` |
| `tab_size` | `tab_size` |
| `word_wrap` | `word_wrap` |

## Keys

The left column is the command or action in the other editor. The other columns are the termocode action it becomes, that action's default key, and what it does. Your key from the other editor is written to `keymap.json` for that action. See [Keyboard shortcuts](keys.md) for every action.

### VS Code, VSCodium, Cursor and Windsurf

| Command in the other editor | termocode action | Default key | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `editor.action.commentLine` | `ToggleComment` | `Ctrl+/` | Comment or uncomment the current line or selection. |
| `editor.action.formatDocument` | `FormatDocument` | `Shift+Alt+F` | Format the active file with its language server. |
| `workbench.action.debug.start` | `DebugStartContinue` | `Alt+F5` | Start debugging, or continue a paused session. |
| `workbench.action.debug.stepInto` | `DebugStepInto` | `F11` | Step into the function call. |
| `workbench.action.debug.stepOver` | `DebugStepOver` | `F10` | Step over the current line. |
| `workbench.action.debug.toggleBreakpoint` | `DebugToggleBreakpoint` | `F9` | Toggle a breakpoint on the current line. |
| `workbench.action.files.save` | `Save` | `Ctrl+S` | Save the active file. |
| `workbench.action.findInFiles` | `WorkspaceSearch` | `Alt+F` / `F8` | Search all files in the workspace (ripgrep). |
| `workbench.action.quickOpen` | `QuickOpen` | `Ctrl+P` | Open the Go to File picker. |
| `workbench.action.showCommands` | `CommandPalette` | `Alt+X` / `F1` | Open the command palette. |
| `workbench.action.terminal.toggleTerminal` | `ToggleTerminal` | <code>Alt+&#96;</code> / <code>Ctrl+&#96;</code> / `Ctrl+T` | Show or hide the integrated terminal panel. |
| `workbench.action.toggleSidebarVisibility` | `ToggleExplorer` | `Ctrl+B` | Show or hide the sidebar. |
| `workbench.action.zenMode` | `ToggleZenMode` | `Alt+Z` | Turn Zen mode on or off. |
| `workbench.view.explorer` | `FocusExplorer` |   | Move focus to the sidebar. |

### Zed

| Command in the other editor | termocode action | Default key | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command_palette::Toggle` | `CommandPalette` | `Alt+X` / `F1` | Open the command palette. |
| `pane::CloseActiveItem` | `CloseBuffer` | `Ctrl+W` | Close the active editor tab. |
| `terminal::Toggle` | `ToggleTerminal` | <code>Alt+&#96;</code> / <code>Ctrl+&#96;</code> / `Ctrl+T` | Show or hide the integrated terminal panel. |
| `workspace::ActivateFile` | `QuickOpen` | `Ctrl+P` | Open the Go to File picker. |
| `workspace::Save` | `Save` | `Ctrl+S` | Save the active file. |

Helix key bindings are not imported. They belong to Helix's own editing modes, so every one shows as *not imported* in the review panel.

## Extensions and plug-ins

Extensions are never installed. A known one becomes a *suggestion*: the language servers or debuggers to add yourself with **LSP: Manage Language Servers...**, or a note about the built-in feature that does the same job.
